name: craft-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog and WebGL/Three.js effects (craft-layer), plus ui-ux (shadcn and Tailwind skills, the WCAG audit) and ui-libraries (ReUI, Aceternity, Astryx, MUI and the library-agnostic floor), CSS-variable theming with a live colour preview, and the accessibility engineer that applies an audit's fix list. Live component-registry lookups route to the registries' own MCP servers — shadcn's and ReUI's — named in the stack skills; this marketplace ships none. plus skill-router, so craft-layer's three.js, scroll, motion-tier and information-design skills load when their libraries are imported. Uninstall with /craft-suite:uninstall.
